mapper.sql: s.id AS database_id, s.business_id, s.name, s.description, s.prompt, s.created_at, s.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT id AS database_id, business_id, name, description, prompt, created_at, updated_at FROM digital_team_skill ORDER BY name
SELECT , ps.enabled FROM digital_team_skill s JOIN digital_team_project_skill ps ON ps.skill_id = s.business_id WHERE ps.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ps.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY s.name
